title: 第210章 四杰七秀第209章 百年地钟乳
slug: 每日情报从打渔人开始武道通神
lines: 守冲接过纸页，逐行细看，嘴唇翕动喃喃默念。
片刻后，他将纸页郑重收好，双手合十，深揖道：
“大善！”
“多谢小施主成全！”
“此举于我慈恩寺而言，功德无量！”
沈修寒忙侧开身子道：
“大师客气了，万万使不得，折煞晚辈了。”
说起来，今儿这桩买卖，他简直赚大发了。
一门早已烂熟于心、且随时能推演升级的『惊鸿游龙』步法，能白嫖到五滴『百年地钟乳』，简直是天上掉馅饼。
若换作其他罡劲大能、罗汉高修，一句话就能让他乖乖奉上功法，哪舍得用这等宝物交换？
得了实惠，牢沈心思顿时活络起来。
他看了眼破庙，好奇道：
“大师，您此番入大齐地界，于这千池岛的废墟破庙中，打算待上多久？”
见守冲只笑不答，沈修寒轻咳一声，大献殷勤补充：
“实不相瞒，晚辈在这岛上行当差事，多少有几分薄面，大师若是嫌此地清苦，不妨由我遣个小厮过来，每日端茶倒水、使唤打杂…”
然而，守冲老僧只是微笑摇头，一副超然物外的模样：
“阿弥陀佛，老衲重入齐地，皆为因缘而来，等缘尽了，贫僧自会离去，便不劳烦小施主费心了。”
咱就说不当谜语人会死吗？
沈修寒嘴角一抽，实在忍不了了，心中默念：
‘情报！’
【提示：本日情报已使用完毕。】
操，给整忘了！
沈修寒无语，心中暗骂了一句。
早时为确定苍梧六魔之事，便将情报早早用了。
想在查探，唯有等明日了。
就在沈修寒腹诽之际。
守冲老僧神情微动，白眉耸起，偏头望向下方，道：
“因果循环，来去匆匆，小施主，且去吧，外面有人寻你来了。”
果不其然。
远处，几声焦急的大喊穿过翠竹林海，传进沈修寒耳中。
其中一道略显耳熟…
‘段红绫？’
‘她将那丁翃打杀了？’
content_en:
Shouchong took the page and read it line by line, his lips moved and he murmured silently.
After a while, he solemnly put the pages away, clasped his hands together, and said deeply:
"Great kindness!"
"Thank you so much, little benefactor!"
"This move will be of immeasurable merit to our Ci'en Temple!"
Shen Xiuhan hurriedly turned sideways and said:
"Master, you're too polite. You must not do anything like this. It would be a disgrace to this junior."
Speaking of which, he has made a fortune from this business today.
The "Jinghong Wandering Dragon" footwork that is already familiar to the heart and can be deduced and upgraded at any time, and being able to get five drops of "Century-year Stalactite" for free is simply pie in the sky.
If it were another powerful Gang Jin or high cultivator of Arhat, he could obediently offer his skills with just one word. How could he be willing to exchange such treasures?
After receiving the benefits, my mind suddenly became more active.
He glanced at the ruined temple and said curiously:
"Master, how long do you plan to stay in the ruined temple of Qianchi Island when you enter Daqi?"
Seeing that Shouchong only smiled but did not answer, Shen Xiuhan coughed lightly and added attentively:
"To be honest, I'm a bit of a mean-spirited person when I'm doing errands on this island. If you find it hard to live here, you might as well send me a boy to bring tea and water and do chores every day..."
However, the old monk Shouchong just smiled and shook his head, looking aloof:
"Amitabha, I am here again because of fate. When the fate is over, the poor monk will leave on his own, so he won't bother the little benefactor anymore."
"..."
Let’s just say that if you don’t become the Riddler, you will die?
The corner of Shen Xiuhan's mouth twitched, he couldn't bear it anymore, and he thought silently in his heart:
‘Information! ’
[Reminder: Today’s information has been used up. 】
Damn it, I forgot about it!
Shen Xiuhan was speechless and cursed secretly in his heart.
In order to determine the affairs of the six demons of Cangwu, the information was used early.
I want to investigate, but I can only wait until tomorrow.
Just when Shen Xiuhan was complaining.
The old monk Shouchong's expression moved slightly, his white eyebrows raised, he tilted his head and looked down, saying:
"The cycle of cause and effect comes and goes in a hurry, little benefactor, go ahead, someone is looking for you outside."
Sure enough.
In the distance, several anxious shouts passed through the bamboo forest and reached Shen Xiuhan's ears.
One of them looks slightly familiar...
‘Duan Hongling? ’
‘She killed that Ding Hong? ’
